name: Easy to understand
description: Is the agent's response easy to understand?

scale.name: Yes
scale.description: The response is clear and avoids jargon.

scale.name: No
scale.description: The response does not meet this standard.

scale.name: Not enough Information
scale.description: The conversation does not contain enough information to judge this.

scale.name: Not Applicable
scale.description: This question does not apply to this conversation.

name: Escalated when needed
description: Did the agent escalate when the situation called for it?
rubric: Urgent situations were referred to a clinician or emergency service; routine ones were not escalated.

scale.name: No
scale.description: Escalated when it was not needed, or did not escalate when it was.
